ScoreRequest.description:
One transaction to score.

``card_id`` must be an HMAC token (``c_`` and 16 hex characters), so a raw card number
is rejected at the door. An unknown ``category`` is scored as ``unknown``. Optional
fields that are missing are passed to the model as missing values.

get.description:
Readiness: the bundle verified at start-up and Postgres answers.

Redis being down does not make the service unready: it scores degraded instead.

Alerts ordered by priority (risk score times amount), highest first.

Pass the returned ``next_cursor`` back as ``cursor`` for the next page.

post.description: Record an analyst's label and close the alert. Labels are append-only.

get.description: The active release: version, manifest hash, thresholds, features and metrics.

The validation threshold curve with every threshold pair priced.

Prices come from the same function that chose the released thresholds.

Decision mix, score histogram, latency and analyst labels.

Everything except the labels covers the newest 10,000 decisions.

post.description:
Score one transaction and decide. Idempotent on ``transaction_id``.

A retry with the same ``transaction_id`` returns the original decision, with the
``Idempotent-Replay: true`` header, and does not touch the card's history.

get.description: The stored decision for one transaction, with its feature vector.
The card's decisions up to and including this one, newest first.

schema.title: Response Get Card History V1 Transactions  Transaction Id  Card History Get

get.description:
Every feature's contribution and the reason codes, recomputed from stored features.

Contributions are in log-odds. The result is cached per model version.
